component.name: Panna
component.summary: View, annotate and fill in PDF files, fully offline

description.p: A fast PDF viewer written in memory-safe Rust. It never connects to the internet: no accounts, no cloud, no telemetry.

ul.li: Follows your desktop's light or dark style
Uses your desktop's own file dialogs

description.p: Menus fit their text, each tool shows its own pointer, and a Tool options bar pops up for the active tool.
Adds a New button and Ctrl+N for a new blank PDF, .deb packages and ARM Flatpaks.
First preview: open, scroll, zoom and page navigation.
